prompt: In a vibrant anime style illustration, the interior of a bustling fire station serves as the backdrop for a lively morning routine. On the left side of the frame, a firefighter with messy blue hair stands tall, holding a shiny silver helmet securely in both hands. Next to him, near the center, a small orange cat sits calmly on a wooden bench, its tail curled neatly around its paws while it gazes upward. To the right, a woman wearing thick round glasses leans against a polished red fire truck, her arms crossed confidently over her chest as she observes the scene. In the foreground, a young boy in a yellow raincoat points excitedly toward the large garage door, his finger extended straight out. Beside the boy, an elderly man with a long white beard looks down at a folded map spread across his knees, his expression focused and serious. A black dalmatian dog lies on the cool concrete floor between the woman and the boy, resting its chin on its front paws. The firefighter with the blue hair is handing a pair of heavy gloves to the woman with glasses, who reaches out to accept them. The orange cat is looking at the black dalmian dog with mild curiosity. There is no smoke or fire visible in the station, emphasizing the calm before any potential emergency. The spatial arrangement places the blue-haired firefighter on the left, the cat and map-reading man in the center area, and the woman with glasses on the right, creating a balanced composition. The yellow-raincoated boy stands slightly forward, bridging the gap between the seated figures and the standing adults. Every character displays distinct clothing and features that make them easily identifiable without labels.
